$comment: 2026-09-01: strict turned ON, and the reason is specific rather than stylistic.
With strict:false TypeScript does not narrow a DISCRIMINATED UNION. lib/api/require-user.ts
returns { ok: true; userId } | { ok: false; res }, and every route does
`if (!_auth.ok) return _auth.res;` — which is correct code. Under strict:false the
narrowing does not happen and the compiler reports 'Property res does not exist on type
AuthResult', so the AUTH GUARD ITSELF was the thing that would not compile.
Proven both ways in isolation before changing this: identical error with strict:false,
This also matches the platform default in platform-sdk/config/tsconfig.base.json, which
this repo should extend rather than restate.
